import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_28/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_28/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Join Source1_28_1 and Source1_28_0 on 'school_name'
df = pd.merge(df1, df0, on="school_name", how="left")

# Ensure column order and types as per target schema:
# ['Student ID': int, 'student_name': str, 'gender': str, 'grade': str, 'school_name': str,
#  'reading_score': int, 'math_score': int, 'School ID': int, 'type': str, 'size': int, 'budget': int]

# Convert columns to correct types
df["Student ID"] = df["Student ID"].astype(int)
df["student_name"] = df["student_name"].astype(str)
df["gender"] = df["gender"].astype(str)
df["grade"] = df["grade"].astype(str)
df["school_name"] = df["school_name"].astype(str)
df["reading_score"] = df["reading_score"].astype(int)
df["math_score"] = df["math_score"].astype(int)
df["School ID"] = df["School ID"].astype(int)
df["type"] = df["type"].astype(str)
df["size"] = df["size"].astype(int)
df["budget"] = df["budget"].astype(int)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
df = df[['Student ID', 'student_name', 'gender', 'grade', 'school_name',
         'reading_score', 'math_score', 'School ID', 'type', 'size', 'budget']]

# Write the result to the target path without index
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_28/target_multisource.csv"
df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
